description: This Java class 'MessagesModelFactory' is a factory utility for creating message-related objects such as Message and MessageHeaders, providing builder methods and handling message metadata.

classes.name: MessagesModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for creating message objects and headers.

methods.name: newMessageBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MessageBuilder for constructing Message objects with specified headers.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder (CharSequence thingId)
methods.description: Deprecated method to create MessageHeadersBuilder using a string thingId, now replaced by method accepting a ThingId object.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder (ThingId thingId)
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder with specified message direction, ThingId, and subject.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder (Map<String, String> initialHeaders)
methods.description: Creates a MessageHeadersBuilder initialized with a map of headers.
